messages:
elena (Finance): Heads up 1: planning a tiny canary to convert legacy partner discounts (fixed-dollar) into new percent-tier discounts for invoicing. Want to catch any revenue recognition and line-item rendering issues before a wider rollout.

ryan (Billing): Good call. Are we doing a true A/B or just a deterministic canary group? Need to know for reporting.

tom (Product): Can we do a 1:1 A/B on 2% of eligible partner accounts? A = current fixed-dollar discount, B = percent-tier conversion. Run for 14 days.

nora (RevOps): 2% is fine. Exclusions: any accounts with custom SOWs, named accounts, or active collections. Also leave out partners with payment terms > 30d.

elena (Finance): Agreed. Also need to ensure AR team is comfortable with recognition when percent kicks in mid-billing-cycle. I'll draft journal entries mapping both flows.

ryan (Billing): For previews I will generate unposted invoices and a compare diff for line items. Format will be: account_id, invoice_id, line_items_before, line_items_after, gross_before, gross_after, tax_delta, memo.

ryan (Billing): Quick SQL to pull candidates: 

```
select account_id, partner_tag, discount_type, discount_value, payment_terms
from billing.accounts
where partner_tag is not null
and discount_type = 'fixed'
and named_account = false
and payment_terms <= 30
limit 10000;
```

ryan (Billing): Will mark sample with experiment_id=legacy-discount-canary-186005 and add preview memo `LEGACY_DISC_CONV` if converted.

lucy (Legal): Couple legal flags: 1) Contract riders for some partners explicitly state fixed-dollar credit; we must honor contractual terms unless partner consents. 2) Messaging must be opt-in for any partners with explicit contract language. I'll export a list of flagged contracts by EOD.

elena (Finance): Good catch. Let's filter those accounts out unless legal clears them individually.

tom (Product): For customer-visible messaging, suggest: "We're standardizing partner discounts to a percent-based model to simplify billing. No action required; you can opt out." Keep it neutral.

nora (RevOps): We'll need a partner comms playbook for sales to reach out to high-touch partners. Also prepare a per-partner reconciliation doc for ops.

billing-bot: job: invoice-preview-run started for experiment legacy-discount-canary-186005 (queue id q_77).

ryan (Billing): Ran preview on ~2,100 accounts in the candidate set. Found 74 with tax delta > $5 (mostly VAT edge cases) and 19 with negative line-item totals after conversion (bad!). I'll open a follow-up for the 19.

elena (Finance): Negative totals are priority. Are these due to rounding or applying percent after tax? @ryan

ryan (Billing): Mostly rounding + some where fixed-dollar discount was larger than pre-tax subtotal so percent conversion resulted in negative line items because we applied percent to pre-tax amount. For those we'll keep fixed-dollar for now.

lucy (Legal): Marked contracts export: 63 accounts have explicit fixed-dollar clauses 1. Those are excluded from the canary.

nora (RevOps): I've updated cohort: final A/B size is 1.8% of eligible partners (post-legal & collections exclusions). Dashboard metrics: revenue delta (cohort), tax delta, invoices with negative lines, partner support pings. Link: https://go.redwood/revops/legacy-disc-canary-dashboard

tom (Product): Rollback gates proposed: 
- Revenue delta (net) > 2% over baseline OR
- > 0.5% invoices with negative totals OR
- > 15 partner support tickets per 1k partners in cohort in 7 days
If any gate breaches, pause and investigate.

elena (Finance): Add a soft gate: >10% of affected invoices require manual accounting adjustments.

ryan (Billing): For transparency in finance reports, I'm adding a `LEGACY_DISC_CONVERSION` memo in the invoice preview lines and creating a mapping file for AR. Also creating a CSV of problematic accounts to send to sales.

billing-bot: job: invoice-preview-run completed. processed=2098, negative_line_items=19, tax_alerts=74.

nora (RevOps): Sent the canary assignment to sales leads for those partners flagged; sales to reach out to any with contract riders.

elena (Finance): Accounting note: treat converted percent discount as a contract modification for recognition purposes. I'll circulate the mapping template - link in thread.

lucy (Legal): For any partner that opts out, ensure we tag account metadata `legacy_disc_opt_out=true` and preserve existing discount.

ryan (Billing): One technical ask: During live conversion, should we apply percent discount at invoice rendering time or pre-compute a discount token on account and persist? Live rendering reduces persisted state but could lead to non-determinism in archived invoices. I prefer persisting the computed percent for the billing period.

elena (Finance): Persisting computed percent per billing period sounds safer for audits.

tom (Product): Agreed. Also add a migration flag and experiment id to metadata for telemetry. 

nora (RevOps): I'll set up monitors and auto-alerts if negative_line_items > 10 or tax_alerts > 50 in a batch. Also will redact experiment labels in partner-facing copy.

ryan (Billing): Uploaded preview diff CSV to drive: https://go.redwood/docs/legacy-disc-previews (read-only). Also added a sample bad-invoice export.

elena (Finance): Meeting to sign off tomorrow 9am PT to decide whether to flip a tiny live canary (500 partners or 1% whichever smaller).

tom (Product): I'll be there.

lucy (Legal): I'll join if needed; sending contract list ahead so we can pre-clear any exceptions.

billing-bot: scheduled alert created: legacy-disc-canary-monitor (thresholds set).

elena (Finance): Final note: keep partner comms conservative. No mention of experiment or A/B. Provide clear opt-out and contact.

nora (RevOps): Understood. I'll link the opt-out form and ensure sales has a copy.

elena (Finance): Thanks all, great feedback. See you tomorrow for sign-off.
